source: Transcription of supervisor messages supplied by Ayadil in this conversation. The private chat was not accessed independently.
time_basis: 15:28 and 15:29 as shown in the user-provided messages; no original message permalink was supplied.

messages.text: The team has made good progress in project analysis, system design, documentation, and initial implementation. The report, GitHub repository, task tracker, and prototype are well organized and generally meet the objectives of the current stage. For the next stage, the team should focus on further system testing, evaluating the matching approach, and improving development and code review practices.

В целом ребята хорошо поработали, отчёт достаточно полный. Но нужно ещё подтянуть несколько моментов: чётче показать, в чём именно заключается AI-функциональность, и как будут оценивать её эффективность. Также важно показать реальный вклад каждого участника, историю разработки и добавить peer review в GitHub.
messages.english_translation: Overall, the team has worked well and the report is fairly complete. However, several aspects need improvement: make the AI functionality and the method for evaluating its effectiveness clearer. It is also important to show each participant's actual contribution, the development history, and to add peer review in GitHub.

reviewed_materials: The report, repository, task tracker and prototype described by the supervisor. The messages do not identify a commit hash, so no exact reviewed commit is attributed to the supervisor.
